values.en: Basis characterization of the exterior power

values.zh-CN: 若 $b$ 是 $V$ 的基，则 $\{b_{i_1}\wedge\cdots\wedge b_{i_n}\mid i_1<\cdots<i_n\}$ 是 $\bigwedge^{n}_{\mathbb{K}}V$ 的基，指标类型为 $n$ 元子集 `Set.powersetCard ι n`；于是 $\dim\bigwedge^{n}V=\binom{\dim V}{n}$。Mathlib 的 `Basis.exteriorPower n b` 正是这组基，因此这是外幂的**基刻画**，而非仅双线性/交错性。
values.en: If $b$ is a basis of $V$ then $\{b_{i_1}\wedge\cdots\wedge b_{i_n}\mid i_1<\cdots<i_n\}$ is a basis of $\bigwedge^{n}_{\mathbb{K}}V$ indexed by the $n$-element subsets `Set.powersetCard ι n`; hence $\dim\bigwedge^{n}V=\binom{\dim V}{n}$. Mathlib's `Basis.exteriorPower n b` is exactly this basis, so this is the **basis characterisation** of the exterior power, not mere bilinearity/alternation.
